origin.description: Create an object that encrypts and decrypts with AES.

arguments.name: key
arguments.text: A raw key of 16, 24, or 32 bytes.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.text: ECB, CBC, CFB, or CTR. A unique prefix is accepted.

arguments.name: IV
arguments.text: Initial vector for CBC and CFB, or the initial counter for CTR.

arguments.name: padding
arguments.text: PKCS#7 padding. Allowed only in CBC.

origin.details: ECB encrypts each block on its own. CBC xors each block with the current IV and then replaces the IV with the ciphertext. CFB xors the text with the encryption of the IV. CTR treats the IV as a 128-bit big-endian integer, copies it, then adds one. CBC, CFB, and CTR decryption need a new object with the original IV. Printing the object uses cat, so there is a space before the newline.
origin.value: An object of class AES with encrypt, decrypt, IV, block_size, key_size, and mode.

translation.description: Create an object that encrypts and decrypts with AES-128, AES-192, or AES-256.

arguments.name: key
arguments.text: 16, 24, or 32 bytes, or values that as.raw accepts.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.text: ECB, CBC, CFB, or CTR. A unique prefix is accepted.

arguments.name: IV
arguments.text: Initial vector or counter. None is an empty raw vector.

arguments.name: padding
arguments.text: PKCS#7 padding. Allowed only in CBC.

translation.details: The IV updates as blocks are processed. CTR copies the counter, then adds one as a 128-bit big-endian integer. Decrypt in CBC, CFB, and CTR needs a new object with the original IV. str(aes) ends with a space, matching cat.
translation.value: An AES object. encrypt returns bytes. decrypt returns a str unless raw is True.
translation.example:
from digest import AES
key = bytes.fromhex("000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f")
plaintext = bytes.fromhex("00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff")
print(AES(key).encrypt(plaintext))
